_doc: Enemy morale, read by scripts/combat/morale.gd. A losing enemy breaks ONCE per fight: when its hull is at or under break_hull of its maximum, or when no weapon of it has been able to fire for unarmed_s seconds. It then rolls its style (styles: the weights of surrender, flee and fight; a design picks one with "morale" in its `ai` entry, else `default`). SURRENDER: it holds fire and cuts throttle and offers `offer` for offer_s seconds (Y accepts; any damage you deal to it, or the time running out, and it fights to the end). The offer is credits [min, max] (base, tier 1: the campaign multiplies it), one of `extra` (item and a count range) and, with part_chance, one of its intact parts. FLEE: it turns its stern to you and burns while its jump drive charges for spool_s seconds; the charge holds (Morale.spool_hold, the rule that also holds the player's own J spool) while every engine of the ship is out (disabled, offline or unpowered), or its helm is down (none working and powered), or every crew member aboard is down. At full charge it is gone (moved escape_distance px away). CAPTURED: if its crew was aboard and every member is down (or none is left) for captured_s seconds, the ship goes dark and is yours. refused_banner_s: how long the banner "They take that as a no" stays up.
